title: Basic Muffin Mix
description: A simple, dependable base recipe — sweet or savoury, load it up any way you like.

method.instruction: Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F). Grease a 12-cup muffin tin or line with paper liners.
In a large bowl, mix the dry ingredients (both flours and sugar). Add your chosen additions (chocolate chips, fruit, etc.) and stir to combine.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the oil, egg, and milk until well combined.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients. Mix gently with a spatula until just combined — the batter should be slightly lumpy. Do not overmix or the muffins will be tough.
Divide the mixture evenly between the muffin cups, filling each about 3/4 full.
Bake for 18-22 minutes, or until a skewer inserted into the center comes out clean and the tops are golden and spring back when lightly touched.
Cool in the tin for 5 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack. Serve warm or at room temperature.

notes.title: Don't Overmix
notes.content: The secret to tender muffins is gentle mixing. Lumpy batter is perfect — overmixing develops gluten and makes muffins tough and dense.

notes.title: Sweet Variations
notes.content: Try blueberry, chocolate chip, apple cinnamon, lemon poppy seed, or banana walnut. Add 1/2-1 cup of your chosen mix-ins.

notes.title: Savoury Variations
notes.content: Reduce sugar to 1 tablespoon. Add cheese & bacon, spinach & feta, corn & jalapeño, or pumpkin & seeds.

notes.title: Storage
notes.content: Store in an airtight container for 2-3 days, or freeze for up to 2 months.
